headline: Slot a: MARBLE RUSH shipped — five sky shelves live at /retrogames/marble-rush
lede: PR #3161 merged dd55a07 and the production bundle carries it: an original 3D marble roller at the MODERN bar (issue #3107 stage 1; MARBLE MADNESS stays the faithful 1984 game). One chrome marble with real weight on an analytic manifold — a single friction budget is shared between holding a curve and steering, banking tilts the budget in your favour, and everything the surface cannot hold slides outward until the shelf simply ends.

notes.text: Five seeded sky shelves (FIRST ROLL, SWITCHBACK, BUMPER ALLEY, SWING BRIDGE, SKY SHOT), medals + persistent bests, seeded swing-bridge phases so different seed → different run. Stage is DATA and the renderer extrudes its mesh from the SAME surface function the sim rides — drawn ≡ ridden, pinned by the new rollercheck (29 Node pins, +6 Chrome drive on the lane; edge+budget mutants both die). Autopilot golds all five shelves across 10 seeds, zero falls. Private until Jon promotes.
Slot b's shift interleaved clean: short-order-shout merged #3164. Warden target #3104 was refused (live comments from slot b); the ladder took #3107.

Pinball seed pin still red in contractcheck on main (state.seed is an integer / recordStart, seed=undefined) — pre-existing from #3116, reproduced on a clean main this shift; facts on #3103, expect the next full nightly to trip it unless that lane lands first.

#3107 stays open + game-queue (the issue wants ten shelves; five in). QA polish filed as #3165 (label feedback): mid-stage checkpoints, trick verbs, surface-tone audio, fall camera/tumble. STATE.md rewritten and merged (b174485).
